title: DepRisk audit log entry (v1)
description: One entry of the hash-chained, signed audit log. Entries are stored one per line (JSON Lines) in canonical form (RFC 8785); see docs/audit-log.md.

actor.description: Operating-system user that ran the command.

gitCommit.description: Repository commit at the time, read from .git without running git; null if unknown.

args.description: Arguments as typed. Values of options that look like secrets are replaced by '***'.

inputsDigest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical inputs, lowercase hex.

outputsDigest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical outputs, lowercase hex.

changes.description: Structured list of what changed, from -> to.

prevHash.description: SHA-256 of the previous line (UTF-8, without the line ending), lowercase hex. 64 zeros for the first entry.

signature.description: ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 signature over the canonical serialization of all other properties, raw 64-byte r||s, standard Base64 (see ADR 0005).
